run_images_to_videos_cli: run the CLI tool to convert image directories into MP4 videos using ffmpeg with configurable fps and codec
run_launcher_scan_sequences: run the launcher to scan a data root directory for Aria camera image sequences and process them into videos
run_worker_single_video: run a single worker to download images from a folder, concatenate them into a video, and upload the result
run_node_parallel_workers: run the node function to launch parallel workers that process multiple image directories into videos simultaneously
run_worker_with_transforms_sorting: run a worker that reads transforms.json to sort images by frame order before generating the output video
